name: ascii-count
expr: (() => { const c = { none: 0, color: 0, mono: 0, bsod: 0 }; frames.slice(1).forEach(f => { c[f.op.ascii ?? 'none']++; }); return c; })()

name: export-smooth-0.15s
expr: (async () => { const t = performance.now(); const b = await exportWebM(); if (!b) return null; const u = new Uint8Array(await b.arrayBuffer()); let s = ""; for (let i = 0; i < u.length; i += 0x8000) s += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, u.subarray(i, i + 0x8000)); return { ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t), size: b.size, status: document.getElementById("status-text").textContent, b64: btoa(s) }; })()
